about_the_game:
What an absolutely quirky individual! She has all the trappings needed to be a creature of the night, complete with fangs and a seductive spell... but let us not misjudge her character, for she only wants what is best for her... abigails...~

ABOUT CARMILLA

  • Age: 26

  • Height: 178cm

  • Blood: O

  • Bust size: C

  • Origin: Salem, Massachusetts

  • Interests: Mystery, Darkness, Magical Arts

After her Family was muscled out of Salem by the much stronger Patriarcas, she fully took on her fictious persona of a Vampire, moving Eastwards and "feeding off of innocent villagers". Luckily she didn't hurt anyone, but having natural charisma and a stunning beauty befitting her stylings, she successfully convinced many women to let her "feed" off their kindness, whether it be food, wine or company.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

This DLC unlocks the legendary champion - Carmilla, with 120 trust, enough to immediately reach level 10.

You will also receive an epic equipment set, allowing you to use her in missions immediately, along with a legendary look for Carmilla (or its equivalent in nanites if you already have it).

And of course, by purchasing this DLC, you are supporting us. Thank you!
